title: M*A*S*H Cast TV Screen Photo, 1970s B&W Snapshot, US
description: A black and white snapshot photograph captured off a CRT television screen during a broadcast of the television show M*A*S*H in the 1970s. The image shows two actors portraying U.S. Army Medical Corps personnel in uniform, displaying visible scanlines from the television display. The popular series aired from 1972 to 1983, serving as a key cultural reference point for 1970s American television and anti-war satire during the post-Vietnam War era.
